title: Aquamarine Mod
description: a very very very beta mod that adds aquamarine. will be expanded upon to include dimensions and such!
body:
![checkered stone, deepslate, and granite aquamarine ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/de57bc6b2c6cf494241aacf0fab77454cbdffff9.png)

### AQUAMARINE
A mod that ads aquamarine. It's my birthstone so I decided my first attempt at modding the game should be something small like that.

Adds a sword and a building block. slightly better than iron and slightly worse than diamond. Can be found on levels Y-20 to Y-50. More will be added... eventually... made using MCreator. FOR VERSION 1.21.8 NEOFORGE. DONT ASK ME TO BACKPORT OR MAKE A DIFFERENT LOADER. I DONT KNOW HOW PLEASE GOD 

![cool new badly drawn items, only a little bit worse than diamonds say a valued customer (RIP). items are displayed on aquamarine blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/978240f6538f302983a8b4b83448c2755935f58b_0.webp)

### FEATURES TO BE ADDED!!

throwing knife, aquamarine stairs and slabs, armor (with effects), pickaxe/other tools. maybe even structures and a new dimension if i get crazy enough. lmao
![cool transparent blocks (trans flag pun included). aquamarine block hovering and warping the colors.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/608529cbb34eeec93d34df6c927e2ddd3a703e83_0.webp)

### CONCLUSION

pls provide feedback and suggestions if you want to. thankz!
